mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE CommentTree AS ( SELECT id, post_id, user_id, parent_id, content, status, created_at, CAST(LPAD(id, 10, '0') AS CHAR(200)) AS path FROM comments WHERE parent_id IS NULL AND post_id = #{postId} UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.status, c.created_at, CONCAT(ct.path, '-', LPAD(c.id, 10, '0')) AS path FROM comments c INNER JOIN CommentTree ct ON c.parent_id = ct.id ) SELECT ct.id, ct.post_id AS postId, ct.user_id AS userId, ct.parent_id AS parentId, ct.content, ct.status, ct.created_at AS createdAt, u.login_id AS loginId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reactions r WHERE r.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND r.target_id = ct.id) AS likeCount FROM CommentTree ct JOIN users u ON ct.user_id = u.id /* 🔥 바로 이 부분! created_at 앞에 ct. 을 붙여서 모호함을 해결합니다 */ ORDER BY path ASC, ct.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, parent_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content})
